hero.badge: Free · Built for personal trip planning
hero.title: Every trip, organized in one plan.
hero.description: Save places, build activities with cost and time windows, group them into trip segments, then arrange the schedule on a single timeline.

overview.title: See the whole trip on one page
overview.description: Each plan has a consolidated overview with trip segments, daily spend breakdowns, and the places you will visit.
overview.alt: Plan overview page with metrics, timeline, and cost distribution

timeline.title: Drag to arrange time with confidence
timeline.description: Trip segments and activities are displayed on a proportional horizontal timeline so you can adjust timing and duration directly.
timeline.alt: Timeline view with trip segments and activities arranged across time

locations.title: Save places and browse nearby on the map
locations.description: Paste a Google Maps link to autofill names and coordinates. The map stays next to the list so nearby saved places are easy to review.
locations.alt: Location notebook with a list on the left and a nearby map on the right

steps.title: Four layers that build on each other

location.label: Locations
location.text: Save places you want to visit with photos and coordinates.

item.label: Activities
item.text: Attach cost, time ranges, and one or more places.

unit.label: Trip segments
unit.text: Group activities into a time window.

plan.label: Plans
plan.text: Combine multiple segments into a complete trip.

cta.title: Start the next plan now
cta.description: Sign in with Google. Your data is protected with Supabase Row Level Security.

footer: Travel Planner — a personal project for trip planning.
